title: aldama robusta
intro: Aldama robusta, commonly known as Mexican tea or yerba de la reina, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to Mexico and parts of Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Aldama robusta include calming the nervous system, reducing anxiety and insomnia, and promoting relaxation and sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
